title: Ghon focus and Ranke complex
dek: Named primary-infection radiology. Calcification is a history of negotiation, not a sterility certificate.
story: Wikipedia still teaches the Ghon focus (primary lung lesion) and Ghon/Ranke complex (focus plus hilar node). These are 20th-century anatomic names that show up on CXR teaching files.
Simplfy's granuloma and pathogenesis plates already said calcification is not proof of sterility. This card exists so the eponym searches land on that sentence.
Primary progressive disease, miliary seeding, and later post-primary cavitation are different chapters. The Ghon name belongs to the primary complex, not to every upper-lobe cavity.
deep: A calcified Ranke complex in an IGRA-positive adult is compatible with remote infection. It does not choose TPT by itself.
Children may show a visible primary complex while still needing a disease work-up — see pediatric diagnosis.
Do not call every granuloma on CT a Ghon focus. The eponym is a primary-infection pattern.
Caseum and drug gradients remain on tb-caseum / tb-granuloma.

visual.caption: Primary complex as named layers: peripheral focus, draining node. Calcium is a later paint, not a microbiologic assay.
